main_text.p: Ex Hiphil Futur. יוֹעֲנִי Tempus constituet mihi, Job.9.19. Hophal הוּעַד vide in עוד. Particip. מוֹעָדִים Constituti, מוֹעֲדוֹת Constitutæ.
מוֹעֵד m. Tempus condictum: Conventus, Cœtus; Solennitas: plural. מוֹעֲדִים & מוֹעֲדוֹת.
יַעַט Chald. Consulere. Ithpahel, אִתְיַעֲטוּ Consilium inierunt, Dan.6.8. ט loco צ, pro more Chaldaico, ab Hebræo יָעַץ.
יָעַל Hiphil הוֹעִיל Prodesse, utile esse.
בְּלִיַּעַל Nequam, Nullius utilitatis. Vide & עַל.
יַעַן Propterea, Propter, Eo quòd, Quia.
יָעֵף m. Lassus, Fessus: plur. יְעֵפִים.

page.notes: Hebrew forms and vowel points are copied from the scan as far as legible; the vocalisation of several headwords is uncertain and may contain errors. Page 133 is the printed page number; the Hebrew letters יע at the top are the running head.
